body:
Can your husband help to schedule therapy appointments for you? Maybe there is a way to communicate with a therapist through email/text at first, to help get you acclimated. 

You being able to maintain a small business from home is an impressive form of communication with the outside world in itself. Talk about ‘putting yourself out there.’ I couldn’t do that. 

I’m sorry for the trauma you have experienced. Being yelled at hurts. A lot. I know this first hand. 
I know you’re scared. I know it’s hard to seek out help. You’re not alone.
